description: This file defines types and functions related to channel matching and configuration, including utilities for normalizing channel slugs, building key candidates, resolving channel entries with fallbacks, and nested allowlist decisions.

methods.name: applyChannelMatchMeta
methods.description: Applies match key and source metadata to a result object based on a channel entry match.

methods.name: resolveChannelMatchConfig
methods.description: Resolves a channel match configuration by applying a resolveEntry function to a match entry.

methods.name: normalizeChannelSlug
methods.description: Normalizes a channel slug string by trimming, lowercasing, removing leading #, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, and trimming hyphens.

methods.name: buildChannelKeyCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of unique, trimmed key candidates from input strings, ignoring duplicates and non-string values.

methods.name: resolveChannelEntryMatch
methods.description: Resolves a channel entry match from a set of entries and keys, optionally considering a wildcard key.

methods.name: resolveChannelEntryMatchWithFallback
methods.description: Resolves a channel entry match with fallback options including normalization, parent keys, and wildcards.

methods.name: resolveNestedAllowlistDecision
methods.description: Determines whether nested allowlist conditions are satisfied based on configuration and match status.
